card.name: Digit inside ZIP codes and ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long digit string, such as a ZIP or postal code, NDC code, ISBN, PubMed ID or other ID number. It is usually followed by more digits.

modes.label: Postal codes
modes.description: A digit inside a ZIP or postal code in a mailing address.

modes.label: Reference and product numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a PubMed ID, ISBN, NDC or other long ID.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long number, like a ZIP code or catalog number.
